tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Cities where the marketplace operates, with currency.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search open tasks by text, category, city, location radius, remote-only and budget (major units).

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Full details of a task by id.

tools.name: draft_task
tools.description: Turn a rough request in any language into a structured task draft (does not post it).

tools.name: estimate_price
tools.description: Fair local price range for a task in a category and city.

tools.name: post_task
tools.description: Publish a task on behalf of the API-key owner. Confirm details with the user first. Budget in major units.

tools.name: list_my_tasks
tools.description: Tasks the key owner posted (role=poster) or is doing (role=tasker).

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Offers on a task (all offers if you are the poster).

tools.name: accept_offer
tools.description: Accept an offer (poster only). Creates a booking; online tasks then need payment in the app.

tools.name: make_offer
tools.description: Send an offer on a task as a tasker. Amount in major units.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: Tasker wallet balances and commission due.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Status of a booking you are part of.
